profile_information: prior completed UTC day official 1m turnover distributed uniformly across each observed minute range on a fixed log-price grid
decision_partition: UTC year of available_at_ms, not bar start time
first_executable_price_rule: first observed 1m open strictly after activation; implemented as completed decision availability plus 60 seconds at available resolution
funding: actual canonical Bybit funding events crossed by each counterfactual position
exits: structural stop, value re-entry or trailing auction-state loss, POC or next profile-node delivery; no maximum holding duration and no scheduled close
label_boundary: counterfactual outcomes are resolved or marked no later than the next UTC calendar-year boundary, preventing a training stage from using the following stage's state
model: pooled HistGradientBoosting mean and 35th-percentile action-value regressors; simultaneous symbols compete by predicted action value for the one global slot
development_sequence: 2023 frozen confirmation only if a positive non-sparse route survives
